angellist-angellist:lever:2ece1547-3b0d-.title: Marketing Intelligence Lead
angellist-angellist:lever:2ece1547-3b0d-.description: Why Join AngelList We’re solving some of the hardest problems in venture capital and private markets. You’ll work with a team that values precision, urgency, and long-term thinking. If you want to shape how startups are funded and built, this is the place. About AngelList We exist to accelerate innovation by increasing the number of successful startups in the world. We do this by building the financial infrastructure that makes it easier for more people to invest in world-changing companies. AngelList is the nexus of venture capital and the startup community. We support $171B+ in assets and have powered investments into over 13,000 startups—over 300 of which are unicorns. Today, 57% of top-tier U.S. VC deals involve investors on AngelList. While our scale is large, our ambition is larger. If you're excited to build the future of private markets, come build with us. About the Role: This is a chance to rebuild marketing ops from first principles, designed around what AI makes possible. We need a clearer perspective on where to invest marketing dollars and why. This role exists to build that clarity. You'll own the marketing tech stack, full-funnel reporting, and market intelligence insights that guide where dollars go. You'll be the natural partner to marketers running experiments: the source of truth who provides data backing and builds the instrumentation (dashboards, signals, measurement systems) that tells us what's working and what we're missing. This role requires wide altitude coverage: executive-level strategy partnership and hands-on technical execution. You'll sit at the intersection of marketing, sales, and executive leadership. You’ll frame what the numbers mean and what we should do about them. Hands-on execution is required because the person making strategic recommendations is the same person who understands exactly how the data is built, where it breaks, and what it can't tell you. The right candidate is comfortable moving between these modes daily.
responsibilities: Own the marketing tech stack and roadmap, evaluating new tools and replacing what isn't working as the function evolves.
Serve as the source of truth on marketing performance, building dashboards and measurement systems that surface what's working and what's not.
Translate performance data into executive-ready narratives that enable confident investment decisions.
Reimagine marketing ops for where the function is going, using AI-native workflows and novel instrumentation rather than standard playbooks.

Develop market intelligence that informs strategy and tactics, using internal data, public filings (Form D / ADV), and competitive analysis to identify growth opportunities and advise on market positioning.

axiomtalentplatform-axiomtalentplatform:.description: Join Our Team as an Oil & Gas Attorney at Axiom Location: Oklahoma City We are currently seeking Energy Lawyers specializing in Oil & Gas to work with our global clients in the energy industry. In this role, you will provide expert legal advice and support to our clients in energy sector, ensuring compliance and mitigating risk. This position offers a unique opportunity to collaborate with leading clients in Oil & Gas, shaping legal strategies and driving business success. This is an existing vacancy. Responsibilities: Advise clients on regulatory compliance matters related to oil and gas exploration, production, and transportation, including environmental regulations, permitting requirements, and land use issues. Draft and negotiate a variety of oil and gas agreements, including leases, joint operating agreements, purchase and sale agreements, processing agreements and pipeline contracts. Ensure compliance with federal, state and local government laws and regulations. Qualifications: Active bar license in the state in which you reside. Minimum of 8+ years of experience practicing law, with a focus on oil and gas law, preferably in a law firm or corporate legal department setting. Strong knowledge of U.S. federal and state laws and regulations governing the oil and gas industry, including the Mineral Leasing Act, Clean Air Act, and Natural Gas Act. Experience with EPC (Engineering, Procurement and Construction) agreements. Preferred Skills: Experience advising clients on upstream, midstream, and downstream oil and gas transactions and projects. Excellent communication, negotiation, and analytical skills, with the ability to effectively advise clients and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams. Experience with energy commodities with an emphasis on pipelines and terminals, and experience counselling on energy compliance matters. Energy-specific data centre experience (acquisition/leases/commercial contracts that have to do with acquiring or leasing into data centres - i.e., power purchase agreements/power supply/utilities). FERC experience (regulatory). Compensation: The estimated total compensation for full-time Axiom attorney roles is $104,500-325,000 per year and for non-attorney roles is $71,250-309,750 per year. Compensation decisions are based on various factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, certifications, location, and business needs. Employees may be eligible for additional benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance; paid holidays and PTO; flexible work arrangements; and professional development opportunities and tools. About Axiom: For over 25 years, Axiom has pioneered the alternative legal services industry, now serving more than 1,500 legal departments globally with our unique blend of world-class legal talent and advanced AI tools, delivering innovative solutions ranging from that combine top-tier talent with cutting-edge technology. We tackle complex legal matters across 12 practice areas for clients ranging from Fortune 100 to SMBs, empowering our legal professionals to engage in meaningful work that advances their careers. Our Talent NPS score of +71% and our Client NPS score of +64% highlight our commitment to excellence ( Reported scores were Axiom’s average for 2025 – the legal industry average NPS score is +35% ). Join our forward-thinking community where you’ll keep your career dynamic and multi-faceted, be part of a company that values agility, collaboration, and excellence, and love both the law and your life. Learn more about life at Axiom . Axiom is the global leader in high-caliber, on-demand legal talent. Covering North America, the UK, Europe, and APAC, we enable legal departments to drive efficiency and growth and meet the demands of today’s business landscape with best in class alterative legal services. jobgether-jobgether:lever:018bc141-6657-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Integration Specialist based in India. This is a customer-facing technical role that sits at the intersection of customers, Product, Engineering, QA, and Customer Experience teams. You will take ownership of integration and technical issues from initial investigation through final resolution. The role combines strong communication skills with practical knowledge of APIs, web technologies, debugging, and SaaS integrations. You will translate customer needs into actionable technical requirements and collaborate with internal teams to deliver effective solutions. You’ll also test fixes, investigate root causes, document recurring issues, and communicate solutions clearly to customers. Success in this position requires curiosity, ownership, and the ability to navigate complex problems without simply passing tickets between teams. It’s an opportunity to make a direct impact on customer experience while working in a fast-paced, collaborative product environment. Own technical and integration-related customer queries end-to-end, from initial acknowledgement and investigation through resolution. Understand customer requirements and translate them into clear technical requirements, investigation steps, and actionable next steps. Troubleshoot integration and product issues, investigate root causes, and identify appropriate solutions or practical workarounds. Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, QA, and Customer Experience teams to resolve complex customer issues efficiently. Create, manage, and track internal tickets while coordinating with relevant teams and following issues through to closure. Test and validate fixes before communicating confirmed resolutions to customers. Participate in customer calls and confidently address technical, integration, and product-related questions. Evaluate customer requests where an existing solution is unavailable and collaborate with Product teams to determine appropriate options and next steps. Clearly communicate solutions, workarounds, technical limitations, expected timelines, and product decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences. Maintain accurate documentation covering integrations, technical issues, solutions, workarounds, and recurring customer requirements. Continuously develop a strong understanding of the product, its integrations, and its underlying technical capabilities. Identify recurring issues and opportunities for process or product improvements and proactively share insights with internal stakeholders. Requirements: B.Tech, B.E., or equivalent qualification preferred, ideally in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline. Previous software development experience or meaningful hands-on technical exposure is strongly preferred. Good understanding of APIs, REST, JSON, webhooks, authentication, integrations, logs, debugging, and related web technologies. Coding experience is beneficial, although the position is focused on technical integration and customer problem-solving rather than software development. Experience in SaaS, technical support, integrations, implementation, or another customer-facing technical environment is a plus. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to independently investigate technical issues. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Strong ownership mindset and the ability to coordinate across multiple teams to drive issues through to resolution. Comfortable engaging directly with customers and leading technical discussions with confidence and professionalism. Curious, proactive, and willing to challenge assumptions while remaining receptive to feedback and alternative perspectives. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced

jobgether-jobgether:lever:66bbb64e-5fbc-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Owner - Brokerage Technology Team - IFG based in the United States. This senior product leadership role will shape the evolution of technology supporting Medicare brokerage and contact center operations. You will own the product vision and roadmap across Genesys Cloud CX and Salesforce CRM , connecting business strategy with scalable technology solutions. The role has broad visibility across sales, operations, agent contracting, commissions, compliance, call center support, and external brokerage partners. You will translate complex business needs into prioritized product initiatives that improve agent productivity, customer experiences, and operational efficiency. Working in a remote, cross-functional environment, you will lead delivery, remove roadblocks, manage dependencies, and influence stakeholders at multiple levels. The position combines strategic product ownership with hands-on collaboration across cloud contact center, CRM, analytics, and integration technologies. It offers an opportunity to drive meaningful digital transformation in a highly regulated healthcare and Medicare environment. Define and execute the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and backlog for the Medicare contact center technology ecosystem, with primary ownership of Genesys Cloud CX and Salesforce CRM. Prioritize initiatives based on customer experience, agent productivity, operational efficiency, business value, and strategic objectives. Serve as the key liaison between business stakeholders, technology teams, and external technology and vendor partners. Ensure technology solutions support carrier-agnostic brokerage operations and broader business objectives. Oversee the configuration, integration, performance, and continuous optimization of Genesys Cloud CX, including IVR, call routing, workforce management, omnichannel capabilities, and reporting. Lead the evaluation and implementation of new contact center capabilities while managing vendor relationships, service levels, and platform performance. Own the evolution of Salesforce CRM across Medicare sales, enrollment, agent management, and customer service processes. Drive integration between Salesforce and Genesys Cloud CX, including CTI, screen pops, interaction tracking, call logging, and workflow automation. Collaborate with Salesforce administrators, developers, architects, and third-party partners on enhancements, releases, and modernization initiatives. Maintain strong data quality, governance, consistency, and adoption across customer, member, agent, and broker information. Gather requirements and align priorities with stakeholders across sales, operations, compliance, agent contracting, commissions, call center support, and external brokerage organizations. Facilitate Agile delivery, remove roadblocks, manage dependencies, and communicate product strategy, roadmap progress, and outcomes to executive and operational stakeholders. Ensure telephony and CRM solutions meet applicable CMS, Medicare, regulatory, and internal governance requirements. Establish KPIs, dashboards, and reporting frameworks to measure customer experience, agent effectiveness, and operational performance. Use data-driven insights to identify improvement opportunities and guide product prioritization and strategic decision-making. Requirements: Authorized to work for any U.S. employer without current or future employment visa sponsorship. 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner or in a comparable product management role, preferably within a call center or healthcare environment. Strong hands-on knowledge of Salesforce and Genesys Cloud CX . Experience supporting Medicare sales operations , ideally within an FMO, brokerage, or comparable environment. Understanding of carrier-agnostic workflows and CMS compliance requirements. Demonstrated ability to manage product roadmaps,

jobgether-jobgether:lever:79bdcc5b-8408-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior AWS Cloud Engineer based in India. This is a long-term opportunity for an experienced cloud engineer with a strong backend and DevOps orientation. You will design, build, and maintain reliable AWS infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code. The role offers significant ownership across cloud environments, core infrastructure, and infrastructure delivery processes. You will contribute to CI/CD pipelines while ensuring infrastructure changes are efficient, repeatable, and secure. Security and compliance are also central, with a focus on standards such as ISO 27001 and related best practices. The position is well suited to someone who enjoys building robust cloud foundations and improving operational reliability. You’ll work in a remote-first environment designed to support long-term professional growth and meaningful global collaboration. Design, build, maintain, and continuously improve AWS infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code practices. Manage EC2 and other core AWS infrastructure components, ensuring reliability, scalability, and operational performance. Support and improve CI/CD pipelines used to deploy and manage infrastructure changes safely and efficiently. Implement, maintain, and strengthen cloud security and compliance controls aligned with ISO 27001 or equivalent standards. Apply infrastructure and security best practices to improve the resilience, consistency, and maintainability of cloud environments. Contribute to ongoing improvements in infrastructure automation, deployment processes, and operational workflows. Requirements: 5+ years of hands-on experience working with AWS and cloud infrastructure. 3+ years of experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code, including practical experience with CI/CD pipelines. 2+ years of experience managing EC2 and other core AWS infrastructure services. 1+ year of experience working with security and compliance requirements based on ISO 27001 or a comparable standard. Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, automation, deployment practices, and security principles. Ability to work independently, take ownership of infrastructure initiatives, and maintain high standards of reliability and quality. Exposure to SOC 2, GDPR, or other security and compliance frameworks is a strong advantage. Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving infrastructure challenges. Benefits: Long-term, full-time remote opportunity with a global team. Remote-first work environment with flexibility around where you work. Opportunity to take ownership of AWS infrastructure and cloud engineering initiatives. Work with modern technologies including AWS, Terraform, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD. Opportunity to deepen expertise in cloud security, compliance, and infrastructure automation. jobgether-jobgether:lever:f2661829-b229-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Outbound Manager | Revit based in Ireland. This is a high-impact, performance-driven role focused on owning and scaling outbound sales engines for SMB clients. You will manage 4–5 client projects as the lead strategist, taking responsibility for campaign direction, execution, and results. The role combines strategic sales leadership, high-volume outbound execution, client consulting, and technical campaign management. You will oversee multiple campaigns each month, optimize messaging and targeting, and use data to continuously improve performance. Working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment, you will collaborate closely with researchers and senior stakeholders. The ideal candidate is already a strong sales operator who can make confident decisions, challenge assumptions, and move quickly without extensive supervision. This is an opportunity to make a measurable impact while growing into a highly strategic leadership position within a scaling organization. Own 4–5 client projects as the primary strategist and decision-maker, establishing the outbound vision and driving overall project success. Oversee approximately 12–20 campaign launches per month, ensuring campaigns are strategically designed, well executed, and continuously optimized. Develop high-converting outbound copy and campaign templates based on market signals, customer pain points, and relevant buying triggers. Manage high-volume outreach activity, including approximately 2,000–3,000 contact imports per project each month, with a focus on generating at least five high-quality appointments per project. Lead weekly client meetings, acting as a strategic growth partner rather than simply reporting on activity and results. Provide data-backed recommendations, challenge existing approaches when appropriate, and translate campaign performance into actionable growth strategies. Guide dedicated Researcher resources to maintain data quality, support campaign execution, and ensure projects remain on schedule. Manage the technical infrastructure behind multiple outbound campaigns, including numerous mailboxes, email deliverability, CRM workflows, and HubSpot/spreadsheet integrations. Monitor campaign KPIs closely, diagnose performance issues, identify improvement opportunities, and adjust strategies proactively. Maintain strong communication with clients and internal stakeholders while balancing multiple projects, deadlines, and performance objectives. Contribute strategic expertise and best practices to continuously improve outbound processes, campaign quality, and overall team performance. Support and mentor team members when needed, helping maintain high standards in a fast-moving and demanding environment. Requirements: 3+ years of experience in performance-driven sales roles such as BDR, SDR, BDM, Account Manager, or a comparable position where measurable commercial results were central to success. Proven ability to build, manage, and optimize outbound sales motions, with a strong understanding of what drives qualified meetings and pipeline generation. Strong strategic thinking and the confidence to develop, explain, and defend sales strategies using relevant data and performance insights. Advanced familiarity with CRM, sales automation, outreach, and productivity tools, with the technical ability to troubleshoot campaign infrastructure independently. Practical understanding of cold outreach, email deliverability, campaign setup, contact management, and sales technology integrations. Demonstrated experience managing senior client stakeholders and leading strategic, consultative conversations in high-pressure environments. Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to identify performance gaps, determine their underlying causes, and take corrective action without waiting for direction. Excellent organizational and prioritization skills,
